questions2.question2: When was the last time you read a book and how was the book?

questions2_answer.question2: The last time I read a book was last week. It was a mystery novel, and I enjoyed it a lot. The plot was exciting, and the characters were very engaging.

questions3.question3_1: I like reading sports magazines. What genre of books do you like to read? Why?
questions3.question3_2: I have a lot of books for my studies, but I can't remember everything I read. Do you have any suggestions for me?
questions3.question3_3: Children nowadays prefer playing games to reading books. Do you think this is worrying, why?

questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: I enjoy reading fiction, especially mystery and fantasy books. I love how these genres allow me to escape into different worlds and stimulate my imagination with complex plots and characters.
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: To retain information, try summarizing key points after reading, and review your notes regularly. Additionally, breaking the material into smaller sections and studying in intervals can improve memory retention.
questions3_answer.question3_3_answer: It is worrying that children prefer playing games over reading, as reading helps with cognitive development, language skills, and imagination. We should encourage children to balance both activities for their growth.

questions4_main: The club was invited to contribute to the design of the national library. Most people say that the library is a boring place and don't use it often. We need to make the library a modern and exciting place that attracts both young and old. Please contribute your suggestions.
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words).
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words).
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I just heard that the club is asked to help redesign the national library. I think it’s a great chance! We should make the library more interactive with modern technology and events.
What do you think?
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am excited to hear that the club has been invited to contribute to the redesign of the national library. I believe this is a great opportunity to make the library a more engaging and modern place for both young and old.
To make the library more appealing, we could add interactive exhibits, digital learning tools, and areas for social events. Incorporating comfortable seating areas, cafes, and art exhibitions would also attract more visitors. Additionally, hosting workshops, book clubs, and educational events for all ages could make the library a lively community hub.
I am happy to contribute my ideas and assist in any way needed to bring these ideas to life. Thank you for considering my suggestions.
Best regards,
Jimmy
